findings.summary: Migration is presented as mechanical substitution.
findings.evidence: Unconditional mappings omit data-flow, lifecycle, ownership and before/after behavior analysis.
Only API >=12 is asserted despite API 20/22 qualifications; toolchain/device baselines are absent.
References and tests lack locators, dates, ranges, hashes and claim-level source IDs.
No fixtures, commands, baselines, observed results or artifacts; uncertainty markers remain.

findings.summary: Verification lacks operational tool adapter/evidence contract.
findings.evidence: No devecocli/project commands, diagnostics, device selection or negative paths.

findings.summary: Mutation and rollback controls are incomplete.
findings.evidence: No permissions, last-known-good state, retry limits or stop/handoff rules.
Broad migration and question triggers lack routing boundaries.

findings.summary: Stable inputs and evidence outputs are absent.
findings.evidence: No normalized scope/baseline/data-flow/authority inputs or behavior evidence output.
todo uncertainty markers and malformed mapping text undermine reuse.
Derived production guidance is predominantly Chinese.

blocked_reasons: Blocked until migration rules are reconciled with primary sources and version constraints.
Blocked until behavioral inventories, scenario mappings and regression evidence are required.
Blocked until executable tool/test/device evidence exists.
Blocked until corpus provenance, freshness and uncertainty are resolved.
Blocked until authorization, rollback, retry and handoff controls align with Domain policy.
